title: clock_pairs: one calibration pair of the clock-calibration collector
description: One row per line of raw/clock_calibration/samples.jsonl: the performance counter bracket around one system time reading, kept verbatim, with the pair's own half width. See docs/contracts/decoded-tables.md section 5.17 and docs/contracts/timestamps.md section 3.

seq.description: Sequence number the collector gave the pair; a missed slot leaves a gap.

qpc_before.description: Verbatim: the performance counter read before the system time.

qpc_after.description: Verbatim: the performance counter read after the system time.

filetime_utc_100ns.description: Verbatim: the system time as a Windows file time, 100 ns units since 1601-01-01 UTC.

filetime_utc.description: Derived: filetime_utc_100ns as ISO 8601 UTC with seven fractional digits.

qpc_mid.description: Derived: floor((qpc_before + qpc_after) / 2), the counter value the pair stands for.

half_width_100ns.description: Derived: ceil((bracket_ticks / 2 + 1 tick) * 10^7 / qpc_frequency_hz), the pair's uncertainty from the counter bracket alone (timestamps.md section 3).

system_time_increment_100ns.description: The system clock's measured increment the collector recorded for the session (the larger of its start and stop measurements), which the fit adds to every bound; null when the collector could not measure it.
